FZ]a:kK,|i7sjnldaeLH.text:
(character) determines the sprite that the dialogue targets (with the textpointer) and also the sound they make.

(line) determines what they say.

(font) determines what special effect is added to the text (hazy, impact, spook)

(speed) determines how fast the text scrolls. The bigger the number, the slower it scrolls. If the number is negative then the text disappears once it's over.

(size) determines the size.

(emotion) determines the costume name
of the sprite (character) that's talking. If the sprite that's talking doesn't have a costume that's titled what the emotion is typed as, then nothing will happen.

Scroll to the left to see these in action.
